156    /**
157     * Generate random national identification number (cédula de identidad). Ex V-8756432
158     *
159     * @param string $separator
160     *
161     * @return string CNE is the official national election registry org.
162     *                CNE is the official national election registry org.
163     *
164     * @see http://www.cne.gob.ve/web/registro_electoral/ciudadanos_111_129_2011.php
165     */
166    public function nationalId($separator = '')
167    {
168        $id = static::randomElement(static::$nationalityId);
169
170        if ($id == 'V') {
171            return $id . $separator . $this->numberBetween(10000, 100000000);
172        }
173
174        return $id . $separator . $this->numberBetween(80000000, 100000000);
175    }
